deliverables.carry_forward: SCX6/cart relationship, Uno identity, manual RC requirement and separate claim/connection status.
deliverables.planned_change: Add camera, perception, operator viewer/alerts and run archive. Keep no application path to motor/steering/receiver outputs.
deliverables.open_decision: Camera, compute and viewer endpoints remain unselected.

deliverables.carry_forward: 3S propulsion and Kobalt-family auxiliary scope. U5A remains unassigned. No asserted shared ground or proven isolation.
deliverables.planned_change: Account for selected camera, inference/storage/thermal loads and USB power coexistence. No new converter or larger rating is assumed.
deliverables.open_decision: Measured load/rail budget, camera supply/interface and actual Pi identity.

deliverables.carry_forward: Raw-first serial archive, strict protocol-2 validation, nulls, SQLite sessions and distinct physical sample counts.
deliverables.planned_change: Add frame identity/timestamps, inference outcomes, freshness-limited advisory alerts, run context, review and verified transfer.
deliverables.open_decision: Frame timing/error semantics and resource budget require bench evidence.

deliverables.carry_forward: Uno USB acquisition role and unresolved installed sensor/power mapping.
deliverables.planned_change: Show the selected Pi camera interface and operator network/viewer link. USB or CSI remains a decision, not two presumed installed cameras. No vision-to-Uno commands.
deliverables.open_decision: Camera connector/logic/power and viewer connectivity.

deliverables.carry_forward: Three-sheet organization and component IDs. RC sheet retains manual-control topology as untraced until verified.
deliverables.planned_change: Sheets 1/2 add only selected camera/compute/storage loads and evidenced protection/returns. Sheet 3 receives version/scope notes without new actuation nets.
deliverables.open_decision: Camera/Pi load, supply entry, USB coexistence and chosen ratings.

deliverables.carry_forward: Logical component identity, explicit unknown physical connector views and no invented gauge/length/polarity.
deliverables.planned_change: Add the selected camera supply route only after the interface is known. Update connector/connection registers and diagram BOM together.
deliverables.open_decision: Use a complete reviewed USB cable if selected; do not invent USB contact pinouts.

deliverables.carry_forward: Existing sensor profiles stay optional; HC-SR04 availability conflict and unimplemented UART alternative stay explicit.
deliverables.planned_change: Document selected camera/data connection as its proper interface/cable. Visual operator alerts add no Uno buzzer command channel.
deliverables.open_decision: Sensor fitted state and camera cable/connector selection.

deliverables.carry_forward: Owner-confirmed front +X, rear tub hinge, stationary gray frame, lower fore/aft members and upper transverse members. Bucket omission remains a display preference.
deliverables.planned_change: Add only selected camera/mount/cable and any evidenced compute change. Show viewing region as a design reference. Preserve unmeasured dimensions as unmeasured.
deliverables.open_decision: Mount datum, field of view, real cable routing and moving clearance.

deliverables.carry_forward: Fixed outer frame/member-order and rear tipping relationships.
deliverables.planned_change: Change only if the selected camera/mount adds a real interface, interference or documented load. No Rev B cradle/trailer redesign is part of assisted V3.
deliverables.open_decision: Measure actual joints/sections before a fabricated change.

deliverables.carry_forward: Current source envelope and removal/access assumptions retain their original evidence status.
deliverables.planned_change: Recheck camera cable and compute changes against pack/dock access. No new pack, parallel rail or backup rail is selected.
deliverables.open_decision: Actual pack/dock identity and removal clearance.

deliverables.carry_forward: Photo-informed external case orientation. Catalog envelope remains unverified; no assembled IP rating.
deliverables.planned_change: Recheck connector entries, strain relief, thermal path, storage and Pi/camera interface. Revise internal layout only for selected equipment.
deliverables.open_decision: Board/case identity, thermal/resource tests and measured fit.

deliverables.carry_forward: Existing front lighting and reserved sensor references; no fictitious installed ultrasonic geometry.
deliverables.planned_change: Develop camera retention, viewing region, cable slack and removal access. Evaluate fixed-frame versus moving-tub mounting without guessing a location.
deliverables.open_decision: Camera model and mounting datum, sightline and full tub/suspension/steering clearance.

deliverables.carry_forward: Uno R3 acquisition, disabled/null defaults, optional reviewed drivers and no motion commands.
deliverables.planned_change: No V3-specific Uno rewrite is required for camera detection/display alerts. Record an actual enabled-sensor build separately if commissioned. Keep the existing source path as the canonical reference.
deliverables.open_decision: Installed sensors/pins/calibration and deployed artifact correspondence remain open.

deliverables.carry_forward: Strict JSON protocol 2, 115200 proposal, raw units/null flags, sequence/uptime and session handling.
deliverables.planned_change: Do not add detection/alert fields to the Uno wire format or bump its version because the vehicle is V3. A separate V3 sidecar contract carries vision data.
deliverables.open_decision: Any later sensor/unit/key change needs its own explicit protocol review.

deliverables.area: Pi logger, SQL, export and dependencies
deliverables.carry_forward: Raw-first recorder and six existing SQLite tables. Config snapshot, separate valid/sample counts and explicit replay mode.
deliverables.planned_change: A V3 coordinator reuses the telemetry core without overwriting V2 run databases. Add V3 run context, process health and explicit linkage to camera/model/alerts in sidecars. Plan isolated runtime dependencies.
deliverables.open_decision: Module reuse/packaging and scheduling must preserve V2 behavior. Existing strict V2 YAML cannot accept arbitrary V3 keys.

deliverables.carry_forward: Existing capture/open/error checks are a reference, not proof of current fitting or synchronized frames.
deliverables.planned_change: Capture timestamps and frame IDs, preserve video/frame mapping, use a bounded inference queue, distinguish empty detections from failure and record model/preprocessing identity.
deliverables.open_decision: Camera/model/runtime/resolution/FPS and thermal limits are unselected.

deliverables.carry_forward: Manual RC remains the motion authority; acquisition/inference may not issue commands to ESC, steering, shift or receiver.
deliverables.planned_change: Create a V3 run/live viewer with source/freshness/model status and visual advisory alerts. Log alert state and viewer disconnection. Audible/physical alert hardware is optional and unselected.
deliverables.open_decision: Operator display/network location, freshness expiry and alert grouping/acknowledgment.

deliverables.carry_forward: Raw/media stay outside public Git. Original runs are immutable and replay stays labeled.
deliverables.planned_change: Validate run context; finalize all file checksums, transfer closed runs, verify destination hashes and generate a report from measurements. Keep private credentials and raw archives outside Git.
deliverables.open_decision: Archive destination, optional unattended queue and operator-visible receipt.

deliverables.area: Dataset, labels, training and model registry
deliverables.carry_forward: Seven old class names may be reviewed as candidate labels only. Archive metrics/data and bootstrap code are not trained/evaluated results.
deliverables.planned_change: Define annotation rules, frame sampling, session/day/location splits, pretrained baseline, validation/test procedure and model/dataset/preprocessing hashes. Train off the acquisition Pi using selected available compute.
deliverables.open_decision: Model family, label rubric, representative data, compute and numeric acceptance targets.

deliverables.carry_forward: Stable component IDs, original source quantities and confirmed/conflicting/proposed/unknown evidence status.
deliverables.planned_change: Add selected camera/mount. Keep compute/cooling/storage changes conditional on evidence. Separate planned, fitted and source-listed quantities. Exclude autonomy/sorting poster parts from required assisted scope.
deliverables.open_decision: Part selection and actual counts/ratings remain unresolved; current package provides a planning disposition only.

deliverables.area: Review workbooks, specification and operator instructions
deliverables.carry_forward: Original evidence/receipts retain their vehicle revision. Blank or missing evidence does not become pass/zero. No PDF regeneration before content review.
deliverables.planned_change: Write a canonical assisted-V3 specification and run procedure. Add camera/model/alert/data quality cases to new V3 scorecard/review copies without copying old passed results or unapproved targets.
deliverables.open_decision: Acceptance target values and deployment instructions require selected equipment and real observations.

deliverables.carry_forward: Keep V2 tests and results scoped to their original revision. Current CAD/architecture/QET/WireViz sources remain intact.
deliverables.planned_change: Add tests for frame/data associations, stale/failed/empty outcomes, capture/model failures, resource contention, transfer integrity and no actuation path. Generate only changed V3 derivatives from reviewed V3 sources.
deliverables.open_decision: Real bench/field test procedures, agreed limits and known hardware.

deliverables.carry_forward: Current unit is an uninstalled draft; service restart is not a motion watchdog or E-stop.
deliverables.planned_change: Plan resource-separated acquisition/vision/review supervision and clean shutdown. Start manually, verify real behavior, then create V3 deployment units and operator transfer instructions.
deliverables.open_decision: Actual Pi/OS/permissions, model/camera runtime and benchmarked restart/resource behavior.
